scope: Viewer software only; no Xbox physical parameters adopted

sources.use: Explicit capture release and lost-capture cleanup; clear drag before releasing capture to avoid reentrant cleanup
Default request logging writes to stderr; tolerate unavailable logging sink without aborting HTTP response

harnesses.tests/test_viewer_server.py: Response headers survive simulated BrokenPipeError and closed-stream ValueError
harnesses.tests/test_gamepad_state.mjs: InputSession state and source-mode clearing are unit tested.
harnesses.tests/browser_viewer_harness.mjs: CDP exercises current pointer release and mode changes. Browser focus loss, pointer cancellation and capture loss remain manual acceptance items.

verification.browser_lifecycle_checks: Current browser harness verifies pointer release and mode changes; focus loss, pointer cancellation and capture loss have not been re-run against the current viewer.
verification.old_gpu_service: Ports 8766 and 8767 remained listening; 8767 returned an empty HTTP reply. stderr points to a pipe. A lost logging pipe is a reproduced failure mode, not a confirmed diagnosis of those processes.
verification.new_gpu_service: Patched server on 8768 returned HTTP 200 through local tunnel 9876
